economic_hypothesis: The current alpha leader correctly restricts liquidation authority for a reference-rearmed challenger after a failed nondeployable fill, but its ordinary full-book displacement path can still let the same recovered-without-fresh-epoch opportunity liquidate a funded incumbent. Read-only provenance attribution over union, common-five, joint leader removal and three formal lower-tail cases found 91 fresh-challenger ordinary displacement observations versus 38 recovered-without-fresh-epoch observations; funded fresh campaigns contributed about CNY 6.539m in aggregate while funded recovered campaigns contributed only about CNY 0.057m, with materially worse median funded-campaign PnL for the recovered class. This supports changing authority provenance, not score weights or confirmation timing.

unchanged: all causal scores and entry predicates
acute security exits and reference rearm
two-position capacity, allocation, fees, slippage, liquidity and next-session execution
treatment.authority_rule: When the actual book is full, an unheld challenger whose current campaign provenance is reference-rearmed-without-fresh-epoch may not use the ordinary alpha-decay displacement path to liquidate a funded incumbent. It remains eligible for ordinary admission whenever actual deployable cash/capacity exists. Full-book displacement authority is restored automatically when the existing fresh-challenger provenance state is cleared by actual establishment of new inventory or by a later observed fresh trend epoch. Fresh challengers retain current leader authority unchanged.

causality: All authority state is derived from existing causal campaign trace/inventory/trend state observable by the decision close. No future campaign PnL from the attribution enters treatment decisions.

fixed_screen.promotion: treatment mean(log terminal wealth) must exceed the source-bound current leader and treatment minimum terminal wealth must be no lower than the current leader; MDD/orders/turnover/fees/slippage/exposure remain recorded diagnostics
